workflowOtherRecord: Workflow links must reference another record.

type_concept_description: Define an idea and connect it to the records that use or test it.
type_decision_description: Retain alternatives, reasons and the evidence behind a decision.
type_run_description: An individual attempt, session or material study using a linked method. Keep each attempt and its outcome.
type_experiment_description: Plan a test, record the method, and keep results separate from interpretation.
type_observation_description: Record what happened, with context and evidence in any medium.
type_hypothesis_description: State an explanation, predictions, and how you could test it.
type_protocol_description: Write a reusable method with materials, steps, and quality checks.
type_analysis_description: Connect data and methods to findings, uncertainty, and limitations.
type_dataset_description: Describe measurements, units, collection methods, and data quality.
type_conclusion_description: Explain what the evidence supports and what remains unresolved.
type_reference_description: Keep a citation, source notes, and its relevance to your work.
type_note_description: Start with an open page. Add your own sections, media, and figures.
revisionUnchanged: No changes to the record content or settings.
dateOrder: The start date must be on or before the end date.
dateInvalidDay: Enter a valid date, or choose Unknown.
dateInvalidMonth: Enter a valid month, or choose Unknown.
dateInvalidYear: Enter a valid four-digit year, or choose Unknown.
dateInvalidRange: Enter a valid start and end date, or choose Unknown.
